name: Folio Detective
storyline:
Players take on the role of a detective tasked with solving a series of murder cases adapted from classic works of world literature. Across eight standalone cases organized into three thematic books, the investigation adapts classic histories like the locked room of 19th-century Paris by Edgar Allan Poe, The Murders in the Rue Morgue, and progresses through Victorian mysteries and classic gothic horror tales.

In each case, a mysterious crime, betrayal, or unresolved event has already taken place. As the investigator, you examine the scene and personal records for physical clues, question the witnesses and suspects involved, and uncover the hidden motives, lies, and past secrets behind every story before closing the case file.
summary:
Folio Detective is a 2D detective and murder mystery investigation game inspired by classic literature. Players investigate crime scenes across different historical eras and literary traditions, ranging from ancient tragedies and Victorian detective stories to classic gothic horror.

Gameplay centers on three core mechanics: searching handcrafted 2D environments to uncover physical clues and forensic evidence, interrogating suspects and witnesses by typing free-form questions powered by dynamic AI responses, and cross-referencing testimonies with physical evidence inside a case dossier to deduce the culprit. Each suspect reacts based on their individual personality, motives, and hidden secrets, requiring players to spot inconsistencies in their statements to solve each case.
